messages:
ana: Heads-up — after yesterday's kernel swap we saw a ~12% increase in p99 on Mistral-7b q4f16 runs in the a4g-dedicated pool. RoPE scaling looked fine locally but CI shows tail. Any ideas? :eyes:
lee: Which kernel swap? CUDA kernels or the fused-attn update?
ana: Runtime auto-picked 'kern_v2' fused-attn during compilation. Swap rolled at 02:00 UTC.
sam: Do we have a perf trace or flamegraph?
perf-bot: Profile summary for thread 1772001234:
- total_tokens/sec: 18.9k -> 16.8k
- p99 latency: +12%
- attn_forward kernel time: +18%
- KV cache eviction calls: x3 increase
nisha: KV eviction x3 is suspicious — could be batching heuristics causing cache churn.
lee: We recently tweaked autosplit to prefer smaller micro-batches to reduce tail under high concurrency. That reduces per-microbatch memory but raises eviction frequency.
ana: Repro steps I used: 
```
./bench --model=mistral-7b --quant=q4f16 --seq=2048 --batch=8 --workers=16
```
sam: Link to flamegraph?
ana: https://internal.perf/graph/1772001234
lee: Quick local experiment: pinned kv_policy=sticky + batch_limit=32 in runtime_config. Results: tokens/sec -> 18.2k, p99 reduced ~6%. CPU spin up slightly but tail improved.
nisha: So autosplit change + kv eviction interaction seems likely. Also check RoPE kernel selection: if RoPE scale mismatches we fall back to generic_attn which is slower for certain seq lengths.
sam: Right — we've seen the 1024->2048 boundary cause a kernel fallback before.
nana: Compile logs show: "kernel_fallback: attn_rope_scale_mismatch -> generic_attn" — so that matches.
lee: Proposed immediate mitigation:
- force kernel selector to prefer kern_v1 for seq > 1024 on Mistral-7b as a stopgap
- add kv_eviction_window=200 to reduce eviction churn
- adjust autosplit to account for active_kv_ratio (avoid tiny micro-batches when KV reuse is high)
lee: runtime_config example:
```
kv_policy: sticky
batch_limit: 32
kv_eviction_window: 200
autosplit:
  min_microbatch: 2
```
sam: I'll open a canary PR and run a 12h sweep across seq in {512,1024,2048} and batch in {4,8,16}. @nisha can you prep the perf harness and trace collectors?
nisha: On it. I'll add trace collection, diff view in the console, and instrument kv eviction counters in the runtime.
nana: If canary looks good we either roll back the kernel change or keep kern_v2 but tighten selector heuristics.
deploy-bot: Deploy queued: canary/1772001267 -> a4g-dedicated (pr #4123)
lee: Also add unit tests for kernel selector covering RoPE scale boundaries and seq cutoffs.
nana: Agreed. I'll file follow-ups in Confluence and attach the experiment matrix.
sam: Quick note — if batching tuning increases per-request latency, consider prefix-caching for common system tokens to shave tail p99.
nana: Great. I'll update the ticket with the experiment matrix and summary. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
